title: tridens flavus f. cupreus
intro: Tridens flavus f. cupreus, commonly known as Copper Tridens, is a subspecies of grass in the family Poaceae. As a medicinal plant, Copper Tridens is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Copper Tridens include its ability to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Copper Tridens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
